messages:
maria: quick sync on onboarding bench/validation: current intake leaves padding/hedging underspecified and it trips canaries sometimes. want to align on defaults.
tony: +1. short version: avoid hiding real traffic shapes with blanket padding. but we still need a repeatable way to measure batching impact.
julia: proposal: two-tier golden traces: `golden.real` (sampled from production-like seq lens) and `golden.scale` (synthetic padded runs to hit target batch sizes). gating should use `golden.real` for latency SLOs, `golden.scale` for throughput/scale checks.
maria: sounds good. how do we mark hedged/replicated calls so bench doesn't double-count?
derek: tag hedged attempts with `invocation.tag: hedge_retry`. bench pipeline then filters those for latency metrics but emits separate cost/tail metrics. also expose `hedge_cost_multiplier` per run.
tonY: spelling nit: it's tony 🙂. Also, should hedging be opt-in per model? some models (legacy fp16) blow up cost with hedges.
julia: yes opt-in in model descriptor. example snippet:
```
name: fluent-3b
admit:
  padded_scale: false
  hedging:
    enabled: true
    window_ms: 150
    min_seq_len: 384
```

maria: good. default: padded_scale=false, hedging=false. make teams opt-in for risky behaviors.
derek: gating rules recap: 1) compute latency SLOs only from `golden.real` and exclude `invocation.tag: hedge_retry`. 2) run `golden.scale` in stress stage to validate kernels/throughput. 3) quantify hedging impact via `hedge_cost_multiplier` and `hedge_tail_delta` (p99 delta).
tonY: add automatic soft-rollback: if `hedge_cost_multiplier > 1.4` && `error_rate_delta > 0.4%` during canary window, disable hedging for that rollout and page on-call.
maria: implementers: julia will extend intake descriptor and lint rules, derek will add telemetry tags/alerts, tony will add canary automation to rollout pipeline, bench-bot will schedule `golden.scale` runs and report back.
bench-bot: scheduling note: `golden.scale` adds ~12% additional GPU hours on average. run schedule: low-priority pools nightly; use `bench-bot schedule --tag golden.scale --priority low`.
julia: I'll make a tiny RFC PR with descriptor schema and lint changes today. derek please add telemetry tags by EOD Wednesday. tony can we target canary next Thursday?
derek: EOD Wed for tags works. tony: canary Thursday works for me. maria: thanks all, will follow up with a checklist and short playbook for on-call if hedging auto-rolls back. :thumbsup:
